description: TOC whose next-TOC offset points back at itself
notes: The TOC chain is walked with 'while next != 0'. Pointing next at the current TOC is an infinite loop with no recursion involved, so a depth limit does not catch it; mac_alias hangs here. Expected: the first TOC parses, then the chain is cut off with ErrorKind::Malformed once more TOCs have been seen than the payload could hold.
